showcase.subtitle: Littattafan fonetik masu sauƙin furtawa don yara masu shekaru 4-8
showcase.tagline: Kowane littafi taga ce zuwa wata al'ada ta zamani daban

values.mission: Kowane yaro ya cancanci littafin karatu da ya dace daidai da abin da zai iya furtawa a yau.
values.tagline: Littattafan fonetik masu sauƙin furtawa. Buga a gida.
values.voice: Mai daɗi, mai ƙarfafa gwiwa, kamar malamin Shekara ta 1 mai kirki. Turancin Birtaniya. Ba tallace-tallace ba ko kaɗan.
values.target: Iyayen yara masu shekaru 4-8, 'yan Birtaniya da ke ƙasashen waje, makarantun ƙasa da ƙasa.
values.artStyle: Zanen kartun mai ban dariya da hannu, bayan fage na launin ruwa mai laushi, layuka baƙaƙe masu tsafta, idanu baƙaƙen ɗigo.
values.curriculum: An gina shi kan Letters and Sounds (Birtaniya). Matakai 6, littattafai 32, fonetik mai ci gaba.
values.fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans (yanar gizo), Outfit (kanun labarai), Andika (littattafai — a da g masu hawa ɗaya).
values.differentiator: Kowace kalma mai sauƙin furtawa + bambancin al'adu na gaske + bugawa a gida.

showcase.allBooks: Duk Littattafai 32 — Bangwaye da Sauke PDF
showcase.readerBody: Bincika dukan ɗakin karatu tare da karatu mai mu'amala kalma bayan kalma, labari da murya, da ayyukan fonetik.
showcase.footer: MyPhonicsBooks — An gina shi kan Letters and Sounds (DfE 2007). Ba shi da alaƙa da Read Write Inc ko Oxford Reading Tree.
